text:
I called you. You called me.

We sprang up like rivers.

In the sky there rose

the mingled names.


I called you. You called me.

We sprang up like rivers.

Our bodies remained

face to face, empty.


I called you. You called me.

We sprang up like rivers.

Between our two bodies,

what an unforgettable abyss!

translation.title: Dream
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the repeated call-and-response and the abyss between bodies.
